name: Dr. Michael Gnatz
headline: Independent IT-Consultant / Freelancer
summary:
I am dedicated to providing you with comprehensive support in efficiently steering your projects to successful completion, maintaining the highest standards of quality.

With my extensive expertise in the realm of IT – both as a lead of a software development team within a renowned medium-sized enterprise, and through a multitude of consulting projects – I extend my full assistance across the entirety of the software development lifecycle:

* Java-centric software development
* Conception and realization of software architectures
* Technical project leadership
* Guiding and coaching of development teams
* Proficiency in Microservices, Cloud technologies, and DevOps

The advantages for you encompass:

* Effective and targeted software development within a collaborative team
* Solutions synonymous with exceptional quality and dependability
* Well-devised, scalable architecture
* Methodically structured and sustainable software

Beyond my well-founded theoretical background, I am particularly distinguished by my pragmatism. I enthusiastically utilize my sharp analytical skills and strong communication abilities to empower dynamic teams. My optimum project milieu is one defined by demanding challenges that serve to drive me to achieve peak performance.
